name: Elandra
summary: Elandra is fully upholstered in richly textured fabric, giving it a seamless and sculptural presence. The smooth contours and refined surface create a sense of quiet sophistication, while the tailored finish adds depth and character. Minimal in form yet luxurious in detail, it offers timeless elegance for contemporary living. 61x47x81
